text.p: Today's initial public offerings will be lifted even higher by money managers, seeking a more fully-invested position in their portfolios to be presented to cleints before the close of the third quarter.
"That will definitely help out the IPOs," said Manish Shah of the IPO Maven.

A slew of offerings are due to go public today and many are expected to shine. Univision Communications Inc is one of the hottest IPOs today, according to Shah. The stock priced at $23 and is indicated to open between $28 and $30.
Shah said he also expected Abercrombie & Fitch to continue rising today after its initial surge on Thursday.

Shares of Swiss watch maker Tag Heuer International SA shares rose to 20-3/8 from its opening at 19-5/8. Several market analyst had previously said they did not expect the deal to be a high-flyer. "It's no Gucci," Shah said.
Cox Radio should also perform well. The stock was priced at $19 for its IPO and was indicated at $21 to $23.
Also due for solid openings are CellNet Data Systems Inc and Abacus Direct Corp, StaffMark Inc, Rockshox Inc and others.
